name: @heyloo/supabase-client
description: Typed Supabase client factories shared by apps/web (T5): browser client (@supabase/ssr createBrowserClient), server client (createServerClient over a framework-supplied cookie adapter — Next's src/lib/supabase/server.ts wraps this with next/headers cookies()), and a service-role client for the narrow Route Handler cases that must read/write across RLS (e.g. platform_settings price cards, per FRONTEND_SPEC.md §4.2 — service-role, never client-direct). Also carries the hand-maintained Database row types + JWT app_metadata claim shape read identically by frontend guards and the backend Custom Access Token Hook (CLAUDE.md Rule 2).
